You heard directly from Carlos Ruiz (Master Mechanic): Contact the EVT Level 2 EV certification program today and schedule the enrollment. Patricia approved the $1,400 and told me to book it. I am not waiting another day. Call the training center, confirm the next available cohort that works around my shop schedule, and register. The 60-hour program can run evenings and weekends. I am locking in a start date.

You Research and formally enroll in EVT (Electric Vehicle Technology) Level 1 certification program. Use personal time after shifts this week to identify the exact program Patricia approved for Carlos, pull the curriculum and cost, and submit an application or enrollment deposit. This is the first hard commitment toward the cert — not just browsing, but signing up. I already have electrical in my skill set. This is the logical extension.. Savings grew by $249.
